notes.title: Small fix version 1.2
notes.notes:
The list of bugs below are early finds. In addition to the bug fixes, there is now also a NEW campaign completion online high score screen. Good luck!

Bug fixes:

- Diver bomber would cause the game to crash sometimes
- Crashes associated to pressing "N" to continue
- Crashes associate with launch button and land to sea tiles
- More minor issues that are not critical to game-play

Latest version: 1.2


- Adrian
